question: Motion to Proceed to S.J.Res. 190
bill_title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Executive Office for Immigration Review relating to "Appellate Procedures for the Board of Immigration Appeals".
plain_language: This vote is on whether the Senate takes up S.J.Res. 190, whose official title is “A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Executive Office for Immigration Review relating to "Appellate Procedures for the Board of Immigration Appeals"”. A Yea begins consideration; a Nay blocks it for now.

question: S. 2, As Amended
plain_language: This bill provides $70 billion in funding to the Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement through FY2029 for immigration enforcement, border security, and related activities. A Yea supports passing it in the Senate; a Nay opposes it.

question: Motion to Waive All Applicable Budgetary Discipline Re: Schiff Amdt. No. 5740
plain_language: This vote was on waiving budget rules so an amendment to S. 2 (Secure America Act) could be considered. The sponsor's official statement of purpose for the amendment: “To provide for limitations on judgments, awards, and compromise settlements under section 1304 of title 31, United States Code.” Waiving needs 60 votes (three-fifths). A Yea supports the waiver; a Nay keeps the budget point of order in place, which blocks the amendment.
